mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a cool 50 degrees under overcast skies near Badger Prairie County Park. We are under a Waning Gibbous moon, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

City residents should note that Pellitteri Waste Systems manages our refuse and recycling, with schedules available on the city website. Also, remember that the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do in our area, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market happening today at the State Capitol. You can also catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company throughout the day.
In a report from October 25, local officers conducted a welfare check at a street intersection and ultimately arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for an O W I.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Mint Explosion. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so stop by to enjoy a scoop.
